open.description: The controlled open state of the panel

default-open.description:
The initial open state of the panel when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the panel.

strategy.description: The strategy to use for positioning

allow-overflow.description: Whether the panel should be strictly contained within the boundary when dragging

lock-aspect-ratio.description: Whether the panel is locked to its aspect ratio

close-on-escape.description: Whether the panel should close when the escape key is pressed

restore-focus.description: Whether to restore focus to the trigger when the panel is closed.

persist-rect.description: Whether the panel size and position should be preserved when it is closed

grid-size.description: The snap grid for the panel

skip-animation-on-mount.description: Whether to allow the initial presence animation.

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

debug.description: Log state transitions, events and prop changes to the console. Applies to descendants too.

openchange.description: Fired when the panel is opened or closed

positionchange.description: Fired when the position of the panel changes via dragging

positionchangeend.description: Fired when the position of the panel changes via dragging ends

sizechange.description: Fired when the size of the panel changes via resizing

sizechangeend.description: Fired when the size of the panel changes via resizing ends

stagechange.description: Fired when the stage of the panel changes

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the floating panel. Useful for composition.

translations.description: The translations for the floating panel.

defaultSize.description: The default size of the panel

minSize.description: The minimum size of the panel

maxSize.description: The maximum size of the panel

position.description: The controlled position of the panel

defaultPosition.description:
The initial position of the panel when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the position of the panel.

getAnchorPosition.description:
Function that returns the initial position of the panel when it is opened.
If provided, will be used instead of the default position.

getBoundaryEl.description:
The boundary of the panel. Useful for recalculating the boundary rect when
the it is resized.

initialFocusEl.description:
Element to receive focus when the panel is opened. Defaults to the panel content.
Return `false` to skip moving focus, or `null` to use the default.

finalFocusEl.description:
Element to receive focus when the panel is closed.
By default, the trigger element is focused.

ready.description: Resolves once the element's machine has started, so `api`, state and parts are in place.

api.description: The Zag API of the component. `undefined` until it connects.

restore.description: Function to restore the panel before it was minimized or maximized
